description: P36 (plan M6-M9 §2.13, §5.10, decision 27): who walks the Aldmere March's roads while the giant is there - at most two at once, one every 60-120 s, 120-220 m away, out of view, on a road node. Each entry's members pay kill XP for its first three spawns only. Aldmere's pike columns and cavalry squadrons (stage 4 and up) are neutral while the kingdom is at peace and stop after the crown's parley or a spared Corvane; the sabotage road thins them (no cavalry once the army withdrew); with Corvane struck down his garrison's remnants roam instead. The plan's siege train (stage 5; 2 catapults with crews) waits for engines that can travel with a copy (P32's engines are placed props; docs/systems/P36.md).
